localities.name: Sholinganallur
localities.price_note: Apartments; premium gated communities toward upper end
localities.trend_note: OMR corridor apartment prices rose roughly 8-10% over the past year; Sholinganallur is the corridor's most established IT-adjacent hub with housing from about Rs 6,000/sqft upward.
demand_drivers: ELCOT IT SEZ and OMR IT campuses
Proximity to Siruseri SIPCOT IT Park
localities.supply_note: Large ongoing supply along OMR; absorption strong from IT workforce, but South Chennai holds ~57% of the city's unsold inventory
localities.flood_note: Marsh-adjacent stretches waterlogged in 2015/2023; within NGT's Sept 2025 1-km Pallikaranai Ramsar scrutiny zone

localities.name: Navalur
localities.price_note: Apartments; average around Rs 6,400-7,500/sqft in 2025 listings
localities.trend_note: Mid-OMR hub with average rates around Rs 6,400/sqft and new launches quoting Rs 7,500/sqft; corridor appreciation of 8-10% annually reported.
demand_drivers: IT parks (Gateway Office Parks, campuses between Sholinganallur and Siruseri)
Strong tenant base of IT professionals
localities.supply_note: Heavy new apartment supply from large developers; healthy absorption
localities.flood_note: Some low-lying pockets; named in NGT Pallikaranai-buffer scrutiny list

localities.name: Siruseri
localities.price_note: Apartments; sources vary between ~Rs 4,500 entry rates and ~Rs 6,400 averages for newer projects
localities.trend_note: Anchored by SIPCOT IT Park (TCS Siruseri among India's largest campuses); prices lower than Sholinganallur/Navalur, appreciating with corridor-wide 8-10% momentum.
demand_drivers: Planned metro Phase II terminus (Corridor 3 to SIPCOT)
localities.supply_note: Significant new launch pipeline; still an emerging micro-market

localities.name: Kelambakkam
localities.price_note: Apartments mostly Rs 4,000-6,500/sqft; plotted land generally cheaper per sqft (~Rs 2,500-4,500)
localities.trend_note: South-OMR affordable node (rates broadly up to ~Rs 4,500/sqft at entry level per 99acres-cited data) benefiting from OMR spillover and the Kelambakkam-Vandalur link road; corridor appreciation ~8-10%.
demand_drivers: Chettinad Health City and educational institutions
localities.supply_note: Ample apartment and plotted supply; buyer's-market pricing at entry level

localities.name: Padur
localities.price_note: Apartments; estimated band between Siruseri and Kelambakkam levels
localities.trend_note: Emerging south-OMR locality between Navalur and Kelambakkam with large integrated townships; rides corridor-level 8-10% annual appreciation (locality band estimated from corridor data).
demand_drivers: Large township projects improving social infrastructure
localities.supply_note: Township-scale supply; steady absorption

localities.name: Thoraipakkam
localities.price_note: Apartments; premium projects push the top of the band
localities.trend_note: North-OMR established locality priced above the corridor average (premium listings Rs 42 lakh to Rs 3+ crore); close to Perungudi/Taramani employment and Pallikaranai marsh edge.
demand_drivers: Proximity to Tidel Park/Taramani and OMR IT offices
Radial Road connectivity to GST Road
Established rental market for IT professionals
localities.supply_note: Dense existing stock; limited large land parcels, NGT buffer restricting new approvals near marsh
localities.flood_note: East-of-OMR and marsh-adjacent pockets flooded in past events; in NGT 1-km Ramsar scrutiny zone

localities.name: Chromepet
localities.price_note: Apartments; established mid-market
localities.trend_note: Established GST Road suburb with airport and rail access; GST Road corridor apartment prices appreciated a modest ~2.9% in the last year per 99acres, with Chromepet at the pricier established end.
localities.supply_note: Mature, land-constrained market; mostly redevelopment and small projects

localities.name: Tambaram
localities.price_note: Apartments; mid-segment ~Rs 4,500-6,000/sqft core with newer projects higher
localities.trend_note: Mid-segment hub (cited around Rs 3,850-6,000/sqft depending on pocket) with steady rather than sharp appreciation; corporation upgrade and rail terminal plans support demand.
demand_drivers: Major suburban rail junction / new terminal plans
Affordability vs south Chennai IT corridor
localities.supply_note: Steady supply in East/West Tambaram and peripheries
localities.flood_note: Tambaram West and adjacent Mudichur along the Adyar river basin are documented high-risk flood pockets (2015, 2023)

localities.name: Vandalur
localities.price_note: Apartments; plotted land typically ~Rs 2,000-3,500/sqft
localities.trend_note: Growth node at the GST Road-Kelambakkam link and Outer Ring Road junction; appreciation tracks the Guduvancheri-Vandalur belt's 7-10% annual land value growth (locality band partly estimated).
demand_drivers: Outer Ring Road + Vandalur-Kelambakkam Road junction
localities.supply_note: Plotted developments dominant; apartment supply growing

localities.name: Guduvancheri
localities.price_note: Apartments ~Rs 3,800-5,800/sqft; plotted land distinctly lower at ~Rs 1,800-3,500/sqft (April 2025)
localities.trend_note: One of the fastest-growing GST Road suburbs, with 7-10% annual land value appreciation driven by rail connectivity, SRM University and Mahindra World City proximity.
localities.supply_note: Abundant affordable apartment and plot supply; competitive pricing
localities.flood_note: Some low-lying lake-adjacent pockets waterlog in heavy monsoons

localities.name: Singaperumal Koil
localities.price_note: Apartments (limited stock); plotted land roughly Rs 1,500-3,000/sqft is the dominant product
localities.trend_note: Industrial-belt residential node beside Mahindra World City (Ford, BMW, Infosys, SIPCOT nearby); demand driven by industrial employment, with plots the primary asset class.
demand_drivers: Mahindra World City and SIPCOT industrial employment
localities.supply_note: Plot-heavy supply; thin organized apartment market

localities.name: Maraimalai Nagar
localities.price_note: Apartments; plotted land ~Rs 1,500-3,000/sqft
localities.trend_note: Planned satellite township near Mahindra World City and Ford plant corridor; land rates gaining on affordability and industrial demand, tracking the belt's 7-10% annual appreciation.
localities.supply_note: Good availability of plots and mid-income apartments

localities.name: Pallavaram
localities.price_note: Apartments; average ~Rs 8,400/sqft, transactions ~Rs 8,900/sqft (99acres)
localities.trend_note: Flat rates changed ~18.3% in the last 1 year and ~48.7% over 3 years per 99acres; airport proximity, Pallavaram-Thoraipakkam Radial Road and redevelopment are re-rating the market.
localities.supply_note: Tightening land availability in core; new supply along Radial Road and Zamin Pallavaram
localities.flood_note: Pockets around Pallavaram lake/Periyar Nagar waterlog; hillside areas safer

localities.name: Injambakkam-Uthandi (ECR belt)
localities.price_note: Apartments/villas; Injambakkam ~Rs 7,900-9,500/sqft, Uthandi ~Rs 6,500-8,700/sqft; land parcels ~Rs 7,100-10,850/sqft on ECR frontage
localities.trend_note: Lifestyle/second-home villa corridor: Uthandi showed ~11.5% YoY and Injambakkam ~5.6% YoY growth per 99acres-cited data; premium driven by sea proximity and low-density villa plots.
demand_drivers: ECR six-laning and OMR link roads
localities.supply_note: Low-density villa/plot supply; CRZ rules restrict density near coast
localities.flood_note: Coastal/backwater low-lying stretches and Buckingham Canal edge can inundate during cyclonic rain; elevated plots safer

localities.name: Porur
localities.price_note: Apartments; average ~Rs 8,150/sqft (99acres)
localities.trend_note: Flat rates up ~7.9% in the last year; Metro Phase II Corridor 4 (Poonamallee-Porur stretch trial runs from June 2025) and Mount-Poonamallee Road office growth are key catalysts.
demand_drivers: DLF Downtown / Mount-Poonamallee Road IT offices
localities.supply_note: Strong launch pipeline from major developers; healthy absorption
localities.flood_note: Porur lake-adjacent low-lying pockets waterlog in intense monsoons

localities.name: Poonamallee
localities.price_note: Apartments; average ~Rs 6,100/sqft (99acres); plots cheaper
localities.trend_note: Flat rates up ~8.9% YoY with a visible surge tied to Metro Phase II Corridor 4 terminus and Outer Ring Road; positioned as west Chennai's next growth hub.
demand_drivers: Outer Ring Road and Bengaluru highway access
localities.supply_note: Rising new supply (apartments and plots); still affordable entry point

localities.name: Mogappair
localities.price_note: Apartments; Mogappair East cited ~Rs 10,850/sqft average
localities.trend_note: Mogappair East rates cited at ~22.6% YoY growth (99acres-derived data); mature planned neighborhood benefiting from Anna Nagar spillover and metro access at Koyambedu/upcoming corridors.
localities.supply_note: Tight land supply in core Mogappair; premium for planned layouts
localities.data_confidence: medium; YoY figure from portal data, may reflect mix change; rental yield estimated

localities.name: Ambattur
localities.price_note: Apartments; Ambattur Industrial Estate area average ~Rs 7,400/sqft
localities.trend_note: About 8.8% YoY price change per 99acres for the Ambattur Industrial Estate micro-market; demand from industrial estate jobs, IT parks (Ambit IT Park) and rail connectivity.
localities.supply_note: Good mid-income supply; steady absorption
localities.flood_note: Lake-belt pockets (Ambattur/Korattur lakes) waterlog in heavy rain

localities.name: Anna Nagar
localities.price_note: Apartments (resale ~Rs 10,000-15,000/sqft); new luxury projects can exceed this
localities.trend_note: Prime planned neighborhood with sustained end-user and NRI demand; steady single-digit appreciation with premium redevelopment activity rather than sharp swings.
demand_drivers: Top schools, hospitals, retail (VR Mall, Shanti Colony)
localities.supply_note: Very tight land supply; mostly plot redevelopment into boutique apartments

localities.name: Kilpauk
localities.price_note: Apartments; 99acres cites ~Rs 15,600/sqft average
localities.trend_note: Central premium locality averaging ~Rs 15,600/sqft with ~4.7% YoY change per 99acres; demand from medical/professional community and central-city scarcity.
demand_drivers: Kilpauk Medical College and hospitals cluster
localities.supply_note: Land-locked; supply only via redevelopment of old bungalows

localities.name: Nungambakkam
localities.price_note: Apartments; among Chennai's costliest along with Adyar and T. Nagar
localities.trend_note: Ultra-prime CBD-residential market (Rs 14,000-20,000/sqft) where values are high and steady; transactions are scarce, driven by luxury boutique projects.
demand_drivers: CBD offices, consulates, luxury retail (Khader Nawaz Khan Road)
localities.supply_note: Extremely tight inventory; occasional luxury launches only

localities.name: Adyar
localities.price_note: Apartments; premium pockets (Boat Club side, Besant Nagar edge) higher
localities.trend_note: South Chennai's most sought-after established locality (~Rs 12,000-18,000/sqft); consistent appreciation on scarcity, IT-corridor adjacency and lifestyle amenities.
demand_drivers: Proximity to Tidel Park/Taramani IT hub
Beach/lifestyle (Besant Nagar, Theosophical Society green lung)
localities.supply_note: Tight inventory; redevelopment-driven boutique supply
localities.flood_note: River-mouth fringe streets can waterlog, but core Adyar is relatively resilient

localities.name: Velachery
localities.price_note: Apartments; average ~Rs 9,500/sqft
localities.trend_note: Capital appreciation of ~13.8% over the past year per portal data; positioned as the gateway between core city and OMR/IT corridor with metro (MRTS + Phase II) connectivity.
demand_drivers: Gateway to OMR IT corridor and Guindy
Strong rental demand from IT workforce
localities.supply_note: Mature market, limited fresh land; redevelopment and infill supply
localities.flood_note: Velachery basin is historically flood-prone (2015, 2023 — Tansi Nagar, Ram Nagar, lake-adjacent pockets rank high risk); elevated eastern/Vijayanagar pockets fare better. Treat low-lying streets as high risk.

localities.name: Pallikaranai
localities.price_note: Apartments; average ~Rs 7,500/sqft
localities.trend_note: ~7.1% YoY growth per 99acres despite flood stigma, on affordability and IT-corridor access; NGT's Sept 2025 order restraining CMDA approvals within 1 km of the Ramsar marsh boundary will constrain new supply.
demand_drivers: Proximity to OMR and Velachery employment
localities.supply_note: New approvals restricted near marsh (NGT 2025); existing stock substantial
localities.flood_note: Sits on/beside the Pallikaranai marsh; repeatedly and severely inundated (2015, 2023 Michaung); among Chennai's highest documented flood-risk zones

localities.name: Medavakkam
localities.price_note: Apartments; average ~Rs 7,200/sqft
localities.trend_note: ~7.5% YoY growth per 99acres; a self-sustained mid-income hub equidistant from OMR, GST Road and Velachery via Medavakkam-Sholinganallur Road.
localities.supply_note: Active mid-income supply; marsh-adjacent stretches face NGT approval scrutiny
localities.flood_note: Marsh-adjacent northern stretches are flood-documented; interior elevated pockets moderate

localities.name: Perumbakkam
localities.price_note: Apartments; 99acres average ~Rs 6,150/sqft with newer gated-community transactions up to ~Rs 9,400/sqft
localities.trend_note: ~6% price change in the last year and ~20.6% over 3 years per 99acres; large integrated townships serve OMR/Sholinganallur workforce at a discount to the corridor.
localities.supply_note: Heavy township supply; wetland-adjacent land under NGT/regulatory scrutiny
localities.flood_note: Perumbakkam-Semmencheri wetland corridor is documented flood-prone (2015, 2023); ground-floor and low-lying blocks worst affected

localities.name: Sriperumbudur
localities.price_note: Apartments (thin market); the dominant product is plotted land at roughly Rs 1,600-3,500/sqft (DTCP gated plots from ~Rs 1,595/sqft)
localities.trend_note: Industrial powerhouse (electronics/EV/aerospace parks, 20+ Fortune 500 plants) with land appreciation accelerating on the proposed Parandur greenfield airport ~15 minutes away.
demand_drivers: SIPCOT industrial parks (electronics, EV, medical devices, aerospace)
localities.supply_note: Plot supply abundant; organized apartment supply just emerging — verify developer credentials
localities.data_confidence: medium; prices for plots better documented than apartments; rental yield estimated

localities.name: Oragadam
localities.price_note: Apartments/villas in townships (e.g., Hiranandani Parks); plotted land roughly Rs 1,200-2,800/sqft
localities.trend_note: South India's largest auto/industrial corridor (20+ Fortune 500 firms); Rs 300+ crore state connectivity investment along NH-45/NH-4/SH-57 underpins steady land appreciation.
demand_drivers: Automobile & electronics manufacturing employment (Renault-Nissan, Daimler, Apollo Tyres belt)
localities.supply_note: Large plotted and township supply; end-user conversion still maturing

localities.name: Avadi
localities.price_note: Apartments; ~Rs 4,500/sqft average per portal data; plots cheaper
localities.trend_note: Portal data cites ~21.6% YoY change (likely amplified by new-launch mix); genuine drivers are defence establishments (HVF, CVRDE), rail upgrades and west-Chennai metro expansion plans.
demand_drivers: Defence establishments (Heavy Vehicles Factory, CVRDE, OCF)
Suburban rail and proposed metro extension
localities.supply_note: Growing affordable supply; large developer entry recent
localities.flood_note: Some lake-belt pockets waterlog; core areas moderate
localities.data_confidence: medium; YoY figure treated with caution; rental yield estimated

localities.name: Madhavaram
localities.price_note: Apartments ~Rs 7,000-8,450/sqft; land guide rates lower per silversky 2025 guide
localities.trend_note: North Chennai's breakout market: Metro Phase II corridors 3 & 5 originate at Madhavaram, plus NH-16/Chennai Bypass access; portals report strong recent appreciation.
demand_drivers: Metro Phase II twin-corridor origin (Madhavaram Milk Colony)
NH-16 and Chennai Bypass logistics belt
localities.supply_note: New launches accelerating; still early-cycle inventory
localities.flood_note: Parts of the Retteri lake catchment waterlog in heavy rain

localities.name: Manapakkam
localities.price_note: Apartments; average ~Rs 8,300/sqft (99acres)
localities.trend_note: ~5.1% YoY change per 99acres; office corridor (DLF IT Park, L&T campus on Mount-Poonamallee Road) and Metro Phase II Corridor 4 sustain demand.
demand_drivers: DLF Cybercity/L&T and Mount-Poonamallee Road offices
localities.supply_note: Moderate supply; well absorbed by office workforce
localities.flood_note: Adyar river floodplain edge — 2015-type events inundated riverside stretches

localities.name: Kolathur
localities.price_note: Apartments; ~Rs 7,700/sqft cited average
localities.trend_note: ~8.5% YoY growth per portal data; part of the north-Chennai boom alongside Madhavaram/Korattur, aided by 100-ft Road retail and metro-corridor proximity.
demand_drivers: Proximity to Madhavaram metro hub and Retteri junction
localities.supply_note: Steady mid-income supply; infill-driven
localities.flood_note: Retteri lake catchment pockets waterlog in cyclonic rain

localities.name: Tiruvallur-Ponneri belt
localities.price_note: Predominantly plotted land: Tiruvallur ~Rs 1,800-2,800/sqft (2025) vs Rs 800-1,000 in 2020; Ponneri from ~Rs 1,700/sqft; organized apartments scarce (~Rs 3,500-4,500/sqft where available)
localities.trend_note: Plot values appreciated ~80-120% over five years to 2025 per developer market guides; Peripheral Ring Road, Thirumazhisai satellite township, Ponneri's proximity to Ennore-Kattupalli ports and SIPCOT Thervoy Kandigai drive momentum. Treat developer ROI projections with caution.
demand_drivers: Ennore/Kattupalli port and Gummidipoondi industrial logistics (Ponneri side)
Suburban rail on both Arakkonam and Gummidipoondi lines
localities.supply_note: Abundant plotted supply from organized players (G Square etc.); speculative element — verify DTCP/RERA approvals
localities.flood_note: Mostly elevated agrarian land; isolated tank-bed pockets should be avoided
localities.data_confidence: medium; developer-sourced appreciation figures, plot market with thin rental data
